purpose: CPU-only feasibility pilot; not confirmatory evidence
dataset: Sleep-EDF Expanded 1.0.0, SC subjects 00-19, first available night only
timeline: All complete nonoverlapping 30-second windows; no label-based sleep crop. Unknown/movement windows still seen by adaptation but masked from offline metrics.
preprocessing: physical microvolt conversion; fixed divide by 100; per-window channel mean removal; clip to +/-20 after scaling. No across-window or whole-night statistics.
writable: BatchNorm affine parameters only; all running stats fixed; model.eval at deployment

diagnostics.protocol: predict then update; paired snapshot; future updates suspended

metrics: subject-level macro F1 over fixed 5 labels with absent classes F1=0; balanced accuracy over present classes; kappa; cross entropy; per-class recall; neg rate at epsilon=0.01
selection: No evaluation subject labels for training, checkpoint choice, LR choice, controller or threshold fitting. Evaluation is a small pilot, not a sealed confirmatory test.
stop_gates: Audit and baseline first. If repeated oracle benefit is negligible or deployable signals fail, report negative result and do not escalate model complexity without evidence.
